_aiInstructions.purpose: Generate a video project JSON that can be uploaded into this editor.
mediaProviderRules: For image element src and slide backgroundImage, use direct HTTPS image URLs hosted by Unsplash or Pixabay.
For video element src and slide backgroundVideo, use a direct HTTPS video file URL hosted by Pixabay, such as a video CDN URL returned by Pixabay search.
Do not use Unsplash or Pixabay webpage/search URLs as media src values; use the direct CDN asset URL.
Use GIF URLs as image elements with mimeType set to image/gif so they render as animated canvas layers.
Keep media URLs in supported fields: image and video elements use src; slide backgrounds use backgroundImage or backgroundVideo.
Pixabay's public API supports image and video search, but not audio search; provide a direct HTTPS audio URL from an audio source instead.
visualStyleRules: Make the video feel natural, realistic, and broadly appealing, with footage and imagery that fit the subject.
Create a flowing video edit, not a PowerPoint presentation or slideshow.
Avoid title-card layouts, bullet lists, boxed headings, repeated slide templates, decorative shapes, and abrupt slide-like cuts.
Keep on-screen text brief and use it only when it adds useful context; prioritize the footage.
textHtmlStyles: font-family (use any system font or Google Font from the editor font picker)
notes: Use stable unique string IDs for slides and elements.
For image src and backgroundImage, use a direct HTTPS image asset URL from Unsplash or Pixabay.
A video element with src, x, y, width, and height appears as a movable canvas layer; it plays muted and loops.
Slides may include backgroundVideo with a direct HTTPS video asset URL from Pixabay. It plays muted and loops behind slide elements, replacing backgroundImage.
Use a solid hex color or a CSS linear-gradient string for backgroundColor.

Set transition on a slide to choose how it enters from the preceding slide; available options are listed in supportedTransitions. Each slide boundary can use a different transition. The first slide has no incoming transition.
Use selectedDimension with label Reels, width 1080, and height 1920 for a vertical 9:16 video. Compose and position content for the selected dimensions.

Coordinates and dimensions are measured in pixels.
Use an http or https URL for audio src so the imported project can render it.
All external image, GIF, audio, and video URLs must allow CORS requests from this editor for preview and export.
Prefer direct media CDN URLs over webpage links; do not use search result pages as media sources.
Audio at the top level plays across the whole video; audio inside a slide plays only during that slide.
Do not embed base64 or data URLs in media src values.
